title: A happy band; fifty-two weeks a year
summary: Constant touring from May 1953 to December 1955.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: --psychological problem. Other psychological problems, not that one.
By all accounts, it seems to have been a very happy band.

It was a very musical band, there was a lot of personal respect. I learned an awful lot about people. Looking back, I would hate to say that that never would have happened. It was an experience, a human experience. I hated to be away from the family all that time, as much as you had to be. Both my sons were about ten and eleven; I wanted to be home. The writing time was good.
How long were your tours, as a rule?
Constant; they never stopped. Fifty two weeks a year. It started in May '53 and we stopped in December '55; two and a half
years, a good two and a half years.
